answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the copper of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The falcon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ridge is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit.
